Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished and original logo concept for ToolDawn, an international online AI productivity tools directory. The client rejected a previous round because every design used the same dark teal palette. This round must have strong DISTINCTIVE COLOR IDENTITY. Use exactly the specific concept palette below, no default teal. Design must remain useful and recognizable as a small app/sidebar icon.
Canvas: 1024x1024 square brand presentation, pure white background. Upper area: a large isolated emblem approximately 280px wide centered near y300. Middle: exact wordmark "ToolDawn" centered around y560 in a bespoke clean contemporary sans serif, intentional optical spacing, readable and professional. Bottom quarter: light pale tint of the concept's dominant color, containing a smaller horizontal version of the SAME logo and wordmark in the SAME palette. Do NOT use a black or charcoal background panel. Keep substantial whitespace. Only text is "ToolDawn", no slogan, labels, numbers, watermark or annotations.
Flat crisp vector-like raster artwork, bold controlled silhouettes, purposeful negative space, high quality logo design. No textures, photography, 3D mockups, embossed effects, shadows, tiny details, generic gear or wrench clipart. Do not copy any established brand. Avoid unnecessary decoration. Each concept is a single consistent identity, not a sheet of alternate logos.
Specific direction: Sunrise orange #F05A24 and golden yellow #FFBB22, warm energetic identity. A bold rising semicircle with three broad rays integrated into a distinctive D-shaped silhouette; smart negative space. Charcoal wordmark.
